name: Anri
source:
The Rebel Fighter with a Goal

Cold and calculating, Anri knows how to survive. She's not the type to shy away from danger, but sometimes she needs an extra hand—that's where you come in. Work hard and maybe she’ll give you a little something for your efforts.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1520750067254181889?s=20&t=7sljkuwCRMbHa_q_aEPXMQ]official Twitter[/url]]
